items.text:
Time really flies🚀 Stella Blade PC ver. has already reached its 1st anniversary. Thanks to the support of our fans, Stella Blade has achieved incredible success. We are deeply grateful for your continued support, and we look forward to bringing you more great games and updates in the future🫰
#StellarBlade #StellarBladePC #StellarBladeAnniversary #StellarBladeBLOODRAIN

source_tweet.text:
Today marks the 1 year anniversary of Stellar Blade’s release on PC! 🥳
To celebrate this milestone, Director Kim Hyung Tae has prepared a special message for all of our fans.
You can read the English translation below 👇

[Kim Hyung Tae's Message]
"⭐To all the fans who have loved Stellar Blade and EVE, I offer my most heartfelt thanks!!
Thank you❤️"

We also want to say a HUGE thank you to everyone who participated in our #StellarBlade2ndAnniversary event! We loved seeing all of your amazing screenshots, fan art, and cosplay!
